title: UVM managed memory 访存路径
summary: 缺页不一定要搬页面：驱动可能只给 managed 内存补映射或改权限，迁移也可能在不缺页时发生。文中对照开源驱动源码，跟踪 CPU 和 GPU 两条缺页处理路径。
summary_en: A fault on managed memory may need only a mapping or permission update; migration can happen without one. The article follows CPU and GPU fault paths through open-source driver code.

title: PyTorch 对称内存与 GPU P2P 访问
summary: GPU 直接读对端缓冲区时，读要等对端写好输入，下一轮写入又要等对端读完旧数据。rendezvous 把对端显存映射进本进程，kernel 用普通 load/store 访问。
title_en: PyTorch Symmetric Memory and GPU P2P Access
summary_en: Reading peer buffers creates two dependencies: reads wait for inputs, and the next write waits for peers to finish reading. Rendezvous maps peer memory for plain kernel loads and stores.

title: CUDA 分层与 Linux 驱动
summary: 调用一次 CUDA API，底下发生了哪些 ioctl？文章用 H100 上的 strace/ltrace 实测日志，把 API 调用对到设备文件和驱动入口。
title_en: CUDA layers and the Linux driver
summary_en: Which ioctls run beneath a single CUDA API call? Measured strace and ltrace logs from an H100 map API calls to device files and driver entry points.

title: GPU 互联的软件与驱动
summary: 由 CPU proxy 提交网卡请求时，数据仍可直接在显存和网卡之间传输。各条路径的区别主要在于谁构造、提交网卡请求，谁处理完成。
summary_en: When a CPU proxy posts network requests, data can still move directly between GPU memory and the network adapter. The paths differ mainly in who posts requests and handles completion.

title: GPU P2P 显存访问
summary: 读另一张 GPU 的显存，kernel 照样写 src[i]，指令里不带设备编号。驱动建好映射后，地址翻译找到对端，硬件路由再经 NVLink 或 PCIe 送达请求。
summary_en: Kernels read peer GPU memory with plain src[i]; the instruction names no device. Driver mappings let address translation find the peer; routing then carries the request over NVLink or PCIe.

title: PyTorch Gather 与 Scatter 的前向和反向
summary: 索引重复时，覆盖式 scatter 前向只留下一个值，反向却给两个源位置都传了梯度。梯度沿索引的对应关系流动，配有逐步动画和可运行脚本。
title_en: PyTorch Gather and Scatter: forward and backward
summary_en: With duplicate indices, an overwriting scatter keeps one value forward, yet backward sends gradient to both sources. Gradients follow the index mapping, shown in a step-by-step animation and runnable script.

title: ADB 命令手册
summary: 按命令查询 ADB 的调用格式与选项，区分主机端命令和设备端 pm／am 操作。可搜索参数说明、复制命令，并打印为离线参考，便于调试时核对具体用法。
summary_en: Look up ADB command syntax and options, including host commands and device-side pm/am operations. Search parameter descriptions, copy commands, or print the reference to check usage while debugging.

title: ADB 命令速查
summary: 79 组 ADB 示例按调试任务组织，可查找并复制所需指令。条目注明设备选择、参数替换及适用条件，便于执行 Android 设备连接、应用管理和日志排查。
summary_en: Find and copy ADB commands by debugging task. The 79 examples include device selection, parameter substitutions, and usage conditions for connecting to Android devices, managing apps, and inspecting logs.

title: 目录树生成器
summary: 用键盘或鼠标搭建目录层级，实时生成 ASCII 或 Unicode 目录树，复制到 README、文档和终端。
summary_en: Build a directory hierarchy with your keyboard or mouse, then copy an ASCII or Unicode tree into a README, document, or terminal.

title: Termux:API 命令速查
summary: 在 Termux 中调用 Android 功能时，查找对应的 Termux:API 命令、参数和权限要求。57 个命令条目附有使用示例，可按用途搜索、复制或打印。
summary_en: Look up Termux:API commands for accessing Android features from Termux, with arguments, permission requirements, and usage examples. The 57 command entries can be searched by purpose, copied, or printed.

title: 用 CUPTI 追踪 PyTorch 显存分配
summary: torch.empty 不一定调用 cudaMalloc，del 也不一定调用 cudaFree。文中给出可编译的完整追踪器，订阅 CUDA API 回调，记录背后的分配与映射调用。
title_en: Tracing PyTorch memory allocation with CUPTI
summary_en: torch.empty need not call cudaMalloc, and del need not call cudaFree. A complete, compile-checked tracer subscribes to CUDA callbacks to record the allocation and mapping calls behind them.

title: PyTorch DataLoader 工作原理
summary: num_workers 调大后，每个 batch 通常仍由一个 worker 整批读取、组装，默认按任务顺序交付。附可交互的分片实验和完整脚本。
summary_en: With more workers, one worker still normally loads and collates each whole batch. Results are delivered in task order by default; an interactive sharding lab and runnable script are included.

title: 判别模型与生成模型
summary: 同一封邮件，垃圾邮件占 40% 时后验概率为 90%，占比降到 5% 就只剩约 41.5%。生成式分类器结合各类内容分布与类别先验来推断，拖动先验滑块可以看到变化。
summary_en: One email scores a 90% spam posterior at a 40% spam rate and about 41.5% at 5%. Generative classifiers combine class priors with per-class distributions; a slider changes the prior.

title: 短板效应可视化
summary: 在各阶段可重叠执行的理想流水线中，每项工作依次经过所有阶段，最小阶段处理能力决定吞吐上限。调整木板高度，可观察瓶颈转移，以及多个阶段同为短板时的优化收益。
summary_en: For an ideal pipeline whose stages overlap and whose items pass through every stage, the lowest stage capacity sets throughput. Adjust the barrel staves to observe bottleneck shifts and the effect of improving one of several tied bottlenecks.

title: Chrome 快捷键速查
summary: Chrome 常用快捷键，按标签页、页面浏览、文本编辑、浏览器功能和地址栏分类，提供 Windows/Linux 与 macOS 对照。
summary_en: Chrome keyboard shortcuts for tabs, navigation, text editing, browser features, and the address bar, with Windows/Linux and macOS side by side.

title: Claude Code 速查
summary: 按操作查询 Claude Code 的命令及配置写法，核对权限模式和 MCP 服务器设置。支持模糊搜索与平台快捷键切换，可打印为日常操作参考。
summary_en: Look up Claude Code commands and configuration syntax for specific tasks, including permission modes and MCP server setup. Use fuzzy search, switch platform-specific shortcuts, or print the reference for daily use.

title: Codex 指令速查
summary: 可搜索的 Codex CLI 子命令、Slash 命令和启动参数，附官方文档链接，可打印。
summary_en: Searchable Codex CLI subcommands, slash commands, and launch flags, with links to the official docs. Printable.

title: Colormap 色图速查
summary: 按连续、发散、定性和循环等类别浏览常用色图的渐变示意。
summary_en: Browse gradient approximations of sequential, diverging, qualitative, and cyclic colormaps.

title: CUPTI 表速查
summary: Nsight Systems SQLite 核心表、字段与关联关系，支持按 CPU、GPU、MIXED 和 META 筛选。
summary_en: Core Nsight Systems SQLite tables, columns, and joins, searchable and filterable by CPU, GPU, MIXED, and META.

title: Matplotlib 速查
summary: 对照 Matplotlib 的绘图代码与图例，查找图形样式、坐标轴和标注的设置方法。参考内容沿用 3.5.0 版，图例与参数速记旁提供 API 文档入口。
summary_en: Compare Matplotlib code with visual examples to find plot styles, axis settings, and annotation options. The reference retains the 3.5.0 examples and provides API links alongside diagrams and parameter reminders.

title: NVIDIA GPU 架构速查
summary: 根据 NVIDIA GPU 的芯片或产品型号查找 Compute Capability 与 CUDA 编译支持，核对目标架构对应的 sm 编号和最低 Toolkit 版本。
summary_en: Look up compute capability and CUDA compilation support by NVIDIA chip or product model. The reference maps each architecture to its sm target and the first Toolkit version with native support.

title: Typst 语法速查
summary: 文本、函数、数学公式、表格和页面设置的语法示例，配有效果预览与参数速查。
summary_en: Syntax examples and previews for text, functions, mathematics, tables, page layout, and common parameters.

title: Roofline 性能模型可视化
summary: 比较 GPU 的算力与带宽屋顶线，调整 GEMM、Batched GEMM 和 Attention 参数，观察算术强度与理论性能上限。
summary_en: Compare GPU compute and bandwidth ceilings, adjust GEMM, batched GEMM, and attention shapes, and explore arithmetic intensity and theoretical performance bounds.

title: HTTP 代理与应用配置
summary: macOS 系统代理设好后，浏览器会用，终端程序却常常不走。系统代理只对读取它的网络库生效；附经 Tinyproxy 实测的 curl -v 输出，可见 HTTPS 的 CONNECT 隧道。
summary_en: macOS system proxy settings reach browsers but often not terminal tools. Only libraries reading the setting follow it; measured curl -v output via Tinyproxy shows the CONNECT tunnel.

title: SSH 转发与隧道
summary: 两个 127.0.0.1 写在同一条 ssh -L 参数里，指的却是两台机器。监听端把每条连接的字节装进加密 channel，另一端再新建连接到目标；监听端在哪，决定了访问方向。
summary_en: The two 127.0.0.1 addresses in one ssh -L option sit on different machines. Each connection crosses an encrypted channel and the far end dials the target; listener placement sets direction.

title: VPN 与多重代理选路
summary: 代理规则写了 DIRECT，连接照样可能进 VPN：DIRECT 只表示不经应用代理。应用先按代理配置选端点，内核再按端点 IP 选路，五类路径可交互推演。
title_en: Routing with VPNs and multiple proxies
summary_en: A DIRECT connection can still enter the VPN; DIRECT only skips the application proxy. Apps choose the endpoint and the kernel routes its IP; an interactive lab traces five paths.

title: VPN 原理与路由
summary: 只把 AllowedIPs 改成 0.0.0.0/0，网关出口、域名解析和 IPv6 都还没配好。系统路由决定包进不进隧道，WireGuard 再按 AllowedIPs 选 peer、校验源地址。
summary_en: Setting AllowedIPs to 0.0.0.0/0 still leaves gateway egress, name resolution and IPv6 to configure. Routes steer packets into the tunnel; AllowedIPs then picks the peer and checks source addresses.

title: TorchRec Row-wise Sharding
summary: 每个 rank 要收多少 ID 取决于本批次，TorchRec 当前的 AllToAll 接口要求 CPU 先读回这些计数，才能发送 ID。序列图的每一步都链接到源码。
summary_en: Per-rank ID counts depend on the batch, and the current TorchRec AllToAll interface makes the CPU read them back before sending IDs. Diagrams link every step to source.

title: TorchRec Sparse Dist Pipeline
summary: 训练第 i 批时，第 i+1 批的 ID 已经能从输入里取出，分发它们不必等模型输出。TorchRec 把这次分发穿插进当前批的前向和反向；文中有可交互的三轮迭代时间线。
summary_en: While batch i trains, IDs of batch i+1 can already be distributed, since that needs no model output. TorchRec overlaps it with the current step, shown in an interactive timeline.

title: CUDA Graph 的 autocast 边界
summary: 在 autocast 里调用 make_graphed_callables，FP32 层的梯度可能从 1.001 变成 1.0，dtype 却没变。backward 也在 autocast 下被捕获，矩阵乘降成了 BF16。
summary_en: Call make_graphed_callables under autocast and an FP32 gradient of 1.001 can become 1.0, dtype unchanged. The backward was also captured under autocast, so its matmuls run in BF16.

title: DDP AccumulateGrad 的 Stream 绑定
summary: 在默认 stream 上构造 DDP、换一条 stream 捕获 CUDA Graph，未开 override 时 backward 报 RuntimeError。Reducer 长期持有的累加节点仍绑着创建时的 stream。
summary_en: Construct DDP on the default stream and capture a CUDA Graph on another: without the override flag, backward raises RuntimeError. The Reducer keeps AccumulateGrad nodes bound to their creation stream.

title: NVIDIA GPU 原子内存顺序
summary: 标志位用 relaxed 原子操作，读方看到 1 再去读数据，仍是数据竞争，行为未定义。release 写、acquire 读能把数据写入排在读取之前，作用域还得覆盖双方。
summary_en: Reading data after a relaxed flag reads 1 is still a data race. A release write and acquire read order the payload, if their scopes cover both threads.

title: AArch64 与 PTX 内联汇编
summary: 只把指针交给内联汇编，编译器就看不见它读的那块内存，汇编器却照样通过。约束和 clobber 要写全依赖；异步复制还要用 wait 或 barrier 交付数据，结果才能用。
summary_en: Give inline asm only a pointer and the compiler cannot see the memory it reads, yet it assembles fine. Constraints and clobbers declare dependencies; async copies need waits or barriers.

title: QuACK RMSNorm：CuTeDSL 源码解析
summary: 每行 760 个元素，tile 却有 768 列，多出的 8 列靠掩码屏蔽。文章逐行注释 QuACK 的 213 行 CuTeDSL 源码，跟踪一行数据怎样分给线程、在 FP32 中规约平方和。
summary_en: A 760-element row fills a 768-column tile; a mask hides the extra eight. Line-by-line notes on 213 CuTeDSL lines trace how threads split rows and reduce squares in FP32.

title: GPU 指令发射与延迟隐藏
summary: 一条指令在等 load 的结果，同一 warp 里排在它后面的独立指令也发射不了。延迟能否藏住，要看编译器排出的指令顺序，以及其他 warp 有没有可发射的指令。
title_en: GPU instruction issue and latency hiding
summary_en: A warp stalled on a load result cannot issue the independent instructions queued behind it. Hiding the wait depends on compiler instruction order and on ready instructions from other warps.

title: GPU 访存路径与 Nsight Compute
summary: 同样 128 字节有效数据，间隔 8 个 float 跨步读要碰 32 个 sector，连续读只碰 4 个。多出的流量有多少被缓存吸收，Nsight Compute 可以逐层核对。
title_en: GPU memory paths in Nsight Compute
summary_en: With an 8-float stride, the same 128 useful bytes touch 32 sectors; contiguous, they touch only 4. Nsight Compute shows, level by level, how much extra traffic the caches absorb.

title: GPU MIO Throttle 分析
summary: 采样里 MIO Throttle 很多，kernel 未必在空等：一个 warp 等队列空位时，别的 warp 仍可能发射。共享内存指令的条数影响入队需求，bank conflict 增加后端工作。
summary_en: A kernel full of MIO Throttle samples can still be busy: other warps may issue while one waits. Shared-memory instruction count drives queue demand; bank conflicts add backend work.

title: GPU Scoreboard 与依赖跟踪
summary: Nsight Compute 可能把等待记在一条乘加指令上，拖住它的是更早的一次 load。Scoreboard 让依赖指令等到结果就绪才发射，等待可以沿依赖归到产生结果的指令。
summary_en: Nsight Compute may pin a wait on a multiply-add while an earlier load causes it. The scoreboard holds dependent instructions until results arrive; dependency views trace waits to producers.

title: Kernel Design Agents 与 KernelWiki
summary: “比 cuDNN 快 1.2 倍”，缺了 GPU、dtype 和 shape 就很难用来判断。Kernel Design Agents 先固定验收与测量口径；KernelWiki 要求性能数据带齐上下文和来源。
summary_en: A claim like 1.2x faster than cuDNN means little without the GPU, dtype and shape. Kernel Design Agents fixes acceptance and measurement rules; KernelWiki requires context and sources for numbers.

title: CUDA Named Barrier 与 Occupancy
summary: 把 ready barrier 的计数错写成 64，两个 producer warp 就可能自己凑满一代。ready 与 reuse 两个 ID 分管先写后读与读完再覆盖，barrier 用量还会限制 block 驻留。
summary_en: With the ready count at 64, two producer warps can finish a generation alone. Ready and reuse IDs order writes before reads and reads before overwrites; barrier usage limits residency.

title: Nsight Compute Warp Stall 分析
summary: 一个 warp 在 stall，scheduler 就闲着吗？只有所有候选 warp 都发不出指令，才会出现发射空档；文中用空档里的未发射采样和指令依赖，找出空档在等什么。
title_en: Warp stall analysis in Nsight Compute
summary_en: If a warp stalls, is the scheduler idle? A gap appears only when no candidate warp can issue; Not-issued samples and instruction dependencies show what those gaps wait on.

title: GPU Occupancy 与资源约束
summary: 寄存器用量降下来，occupancy 却不一定上去：驻留 warp 数由最紧的资源决定，共享内存可能接着卡住。多出来的 warp 还得有就绪指令，才能隐藏延迟。
summary_en: Cutting register use need not raise occupancy: the tightest resource sets residency, and shared memory may take over as the limit. Extra warps hide latency only with ready instructions.

title: Triton JIT 特化与缓存
summary: n 从 1024 改成 2048 会复用原 kernel，改成 1000 却要编译新变体。缓存键含参数类型、constexpr 值，以及整数和指针能否被 16 整除；附追踪脚本。
summary_en: n=2048 reuses the kernel built for n=1024, but n=1000 compiles a new variant. The cache key includes argument types, constexpr values and divisibility by 16; a tracing script is included.

title: 组相联 Cache 与 LRU 替换
summary: 四路、1024 条 line 的 Cache 装满后再多访问一条，重扫时 set 0 的 5 次访问全部 miss。地址只决定 line 进哪个 set；按严格的最久未用替换，换出的恰是下一条要用的。
summary_en: One line past a 4-way, 1,024-line cache makes a rescan miss all five accesses to set 0. Addresses fix only the set; strict least-recently-used eviction removes the next line needed.

title: LayerNorm 反向传播与 GPU 实现
summary: 输入梯度只在单个 token 的特征维内求和，参数梯度则要跨所有 token 累加。两个方向决定 kernel 怎么拆；文中 Triton 实现先融合两者，再规约 FP32 部分和。
summary_en: Input gradients sum within one token, but parameter gradients sum across all tokens. The two directions shape the kernels; the Triton version fuses both, then reduces FP32 partial sums.

title: PyTorch DDP 梯度规约
summary: 自定义通信 hook 只做求和，梯度就变成默认值的 rank 数倍。默认路径在梯度写入 bucket 时先除以 rank 数，再按 bucket 序号发起求和，与反向计算重叠。
summary_en: A sum-only communication hook makes gradients world-size times larger than the default. The default path divides gradients as they enter buckets and sums buckets in index order during backward.

title: PyTorch Autograd 反向图
summary: 一个张量被两条分支使用，它的反向节点会被调用几次？一次：两路梯度先在槽位里求和，再调用节点；叶子参数的梯度经 AccumulateGrad 累加到 .grad。
summary_en: When a tensor feeds two branches, how often does its backward node run? Once: gradients first sum in its input slot, and leaf gradients reach .grad through AccumulateGrad.

title: LLM MoE 架构与执行
summary: DeepSeek-V3 总参数 671B，每个 token 只激活 37B。代价是每个 expert 层都要把 token 按所选 expert 重排、算完再还原，跨 GPU 时还要两次 all-to-all。
summary_en: DeepSeek-V3 holds 671B parameters but activates only 37B per token. Each expert layer regroups tokens by chosen expert and restores their order; across GPUs that takes two all-to-all exchanges.

title: SiLU 的 tanh 与 exp2 实现
summary: 把 sigmoid 换成 tanh 写法，为什么可能更快？它用乘加替代 exp2 写法里的倒数或除法，缩短串行依赖链；文章列出看反汇编、测误差和计时的核对步骤。
summary_en: Why might rewriting sigmoid with tanh run faster? It replaces the reciprocal or divide of the exp2 form with multiply-adds, shortening the dependency chain; checks cover disassembly, error and timing.

title: Codex 会话存储
summary: JSONL、SQLite 和 -wal 文件同时出现在 ~/.codex 里，会话出了问题该查哪个？rollout 文件按序追加会话事件，SQLite 存列表和可恢复状态，日志记录运行诊断。
summary_en: JSONL, SQLite and -wal files sit together in ~/.codex; which one explains a session problem? Rollout files append events, SQLite keeps listings and resumable state, and logs hold diagnostics.

title: PyTorch Linear 与 cuBLAS 布局
summary: Hopper 上 cuBLAS 的 FP8 矩阵乘要求 TN 布局，Linear 权重梯度和输入梯度却天然对应 NT 和 NN。cuBLAS 把行主序数据看成列主序的转置，profiler 的转置标记由此推出。
summary_en: On Hopper, cuBLAS FP8 matrix multiplies need TN, yet Linear weight and input gradients map to NT and NN. cuBLAS reads row-major buffers as column-major transposes, which explains these labels.

title: FP8 缩放与训练 Recipe
summary: 同一个大模型里，一个张量的最大绝对值可能是 0.02，另一个是 2000。FP8 靠 scale 把它们映射进有限的数值范围，scale 的粒度和更新时机影响误差与开销。
summary_en: Two tensors in one model may peak at 0.02 and 2000. FP8 maps each into its narrow range with a scale, whose granularity and update timing affect error and cost.

title: PyTorch record_stream 与显存复用
summary: Tensor 在别的 stream 上还没用完就被释放，这块显存可能被新张量占用并改写。record_stream 让 allocator 在释放时给这些 stream 记 event，等它们的工作结束再复用。
summary_en: Freeing a tensor still in use on other streams can let a new tensor overwrite its memory. record_stream makes the allocator defer reuse until events on those streams complete.

title: SWA Packing 与样本隔离
summary: ABC 和 BCD 拼成一条序列，窗口为 3 的滑动窗口注意力叠两层，前一条的 B、C 就进了 D 的梯度。感受野逐层外扩，要用按样本分块的 mask 或 cu_seqlens 切断。
summary_en: In a packed ABCBCD, two window-3 attention layers carry the first B and C into the gradient of D. Receptive fields grow per layer; per-sample masks or cu_seqlens cut them.

title: AOTInductor CUDA C++ 部署
summary: 只有 Python 实现的自定义算子，放进无 Python 的 C++ 进程就跑不了。AOTInductor 离线把模型编译成 .pt2，自定义算子还要备好形状推断和 C++ 实现。
summary_en: Custom ops written only in Python cannot run in a Python-free C++ process. AOTInductor compiles the model into a .pt2 offline; custom ops need shape inference and a C++ implementation.

title: LLM 序列混合机制
summary: 技术报告常把注意力头分组、滑动窗口和 Mamba 并列，可它们改的分别是头的组织、计算范围和历史状态。文章按 token 间的计算形式分类，配可展开的谱系树。
summary_en: Reports list grouped attention heads, sliding windows and Mamba together, though each changes something different: head layout, attention span or history state. A clickable tree sorts them by computation form.

title: PyTorch 共享库构建与加载
summary: libtorch.so 由空源文件编译而成，自身几乎没有代码。import torch 先全局预加载依赖库，再经薄扩展 torch._C 进入 Python 绑定；文中依赖图可逐个点开。
summary_en: libtorch.so is compiled from an empty file and holds little code. import torch preloads dependencies globally, then enters Python bindings via the thin torch._C; an interactive graph maps the libraries.

title: Hopper Thread Block Cluster
summary: 跨 block 交换 tile 或同步阶段，往往要绕道全局内存、原子操作或再启动 kernel。Hopper 的 cluster 让一组 block 同时驻留，访问彼此的共享内存并整组同步。
summary_en: Exchanging tiles or syncing phases across blocks usually means global memory, atomics or another kernel launch. Hopper clusters co-schedule blocks that access peer shared memory and sync as a group.

title: Context Parallel 通信机制
summary: 因果 mask 下把序列连续切给两张卡，第二张卡的 attention 计算量是第一张的 3 倍。Ring 让 key/value 传输与本地计算重叠，重排切分则拉平负载。
summary_en: With a contiguous split and causal mask, the second GPU does three times the attention work of the first. Ring overlaps key/value transfers with compute, and reordering balances the load.

title: PyTorch Dispatcher 机制
summary: 开着 autocast 调 torch.mm，要先过 Autocast、Autograd 两层，才落到 CUDA kernel。Dispatcher 用张量属性和线程状态算出 DispatchKeySet，按优先级逐层往下分派。
summary_en: Under autocast, torch.mm passes through the Autocast and Autograd layers before reaching the CUDA kernel. The dispatcher derives a DispatchKeySet from tensors and thread state, then dispatches down by priority.

title: PyTorch TorchDispatchMode
summary: 在 FakeTensorMode 下做 CUDA 矩阵乘，不分配显存、不启动 kernel，输出形状照样算出。算子进入后端前交给 Python handler，运行期间当前 mode 暂时出栈。
summary_en: Under FakeTensorMode, a CUDA matmul yields its shape without allocating memory or launching a kernel. Operators reach a Python handler before the backend; the mode is popped while it runs.

title: OneTrans 与 YaMBDA 数据处理
summary: 每卡 1024 条样本、序列长 500 时，一个 batch 约查表 462 万次，99.8% 落在三张序列表上。文章跟踪 YaMBDA 的行为历史怎样被切分、打包成 OneTrans 的输入 token。
summary_en: With 1,024 samples per GPU and length 500, a batch makes about 4.6 million embedding lookups, 99.8% on three sequence tables. The article traces how behavior histories become OneTrans tokens.

title: Python 导入机制
summary: 包里的文件用 python a.py 直接运行，相对导入会报“no known parent package”。启动方式决定 sys.path[0] 和模块所属的 package，相对导入从它起算。
summary_en: Run a package file as python a.py and relative imports fail: no known parent package. The launch mode sets sys.path[0] and the package that relative imports resolve against.

title: GEMM 计算强度与分块
summary: 256×64 和 128×128 的输出 tile 元素数相同，K 很大时前者的计算强度只有后者的 80%。计算强度随 tile 两边的调和平均变化，短边限制了数据复用。
summary_en: At large K, 256×64 tiles reach only 80% of the arithmetic intensity of equal-sized 128×128 tiles. Intensity follows the harmonic mean of the edges, which sits near the shorter one.
